host.description: Technical name of the host prototype. Property behavior: required for create operations; read-only for inherited objects.

name.description: Visible name of the host prototype. Default: host property value. Property behavior: read-only for inherited objects.

status.description: Status of the host prototype. Possible values: 0 - (default) monitored host; 1 - unmonitored host.

inventory_mode.description: Host inventory population mode. Possible values: -1 - (default) disabled; 0 - manual; 1 - automatic.

discover.description: Host prototype discovery status. Possible values: 0 - (default) new hosts will be discovered; 1 - new hosts will not be discovered and existing hosts will be marked as lost.

custom_interfaces.description: Source of custom interfaces for hosts created by the host prototype. Possible values: 0 - (default) inherit interfaces from parent host; 1 - use host prototypes custom interfaces. Property behavior: read-only for inherited objects.

uuid.description: Universal unique identifier, used for linking imported host prototypes to already existing ones. Auto-generated, if not given. Property behavior: supported if the host prototype belongs to a template.

ruleid.description: ID of the LLD rule that the host prototype belongs to. Parameter behavior: required.

groupLinks.description: Group links to be created for the host prototype. Parameter behavior: required.

groupPrototypes.description: Group prototypes to be created for the host prototype.

macros.description: User macros to be created for the host prototype. See the User macro object (reference/usermacro/object).

tags.description: Host prototype tags. See Host prototype tag object.

templates.description: Templates to be linked to the host prototype. The templates must have only the templateid property defined.

groupLink.description: Group link object. Links a host prototype with a host group.

groupid.description: ID of the host group. Property behavior: required.

groupPrototype.description: Group prototype object. Defines a group that will be created for a discovered host.

name.description: Name of the group prototype. Property behavior: required for create operations.

tag.description: Host prototype tag name. Property behavior: required.

customInterface.description: Custom interface object. Supported if custom_interfaces of Host prototype object is set to "use host prototypes custom interfaces".

type.description: Interface type. Possible values: 1 - Agent; 2 - SNMP; 3 - IPMI; 4 - JMX. Property behavior: required.

useip.description: Whether the connection should be made via IP. Possible values: 0 - connect using host DNS name; 1 - connect using host IP address. Property behavior: required.

ip.description: IP address used by the interface. Can contain macros. Property behavior: required if useip is set to "connect using host IP address" (1).

dns.description: DNS name used by the interface. Can contain macros. Property behavior: required if useip is set to "connect using host DNS name" (0).

port.description: Port number used by the interface. Can contain user and LLD macros. Property behavior: required.

main.description: Whether the interface is used as default on the host. Only one interface of some type can be set as default on a host. Possible values: 0 - not default; 1 - default. Property behavior: required.

details.description: Additional object for custom interface details. Property behavior: required if type is set to "SNMP" (2).

customInterfaceDetails.description: Custom interface details object (SNMP interface details).

version.description: SNMP interface version. Possible values: 1 - SNMPv1; 2 - SNMPv2c; 3 - SNMPv3. Property behavior: required.

bulk.description: Whether to use bulk SNMP requests. Possible values: 0 - don't use bulk requests; 1 - (default) use bulk requests.

community.description: SNMP community. Property behavior: required if version is set to "SNMPv1" (1) or "SNMPv2c" (2).

max_repetitions.description: Max repetition value for native SNMP bulk requests (GetBulkRequest-PDUs). Used only for discovery[] and walk[] items in SNMPv2 and v3. Default: 10.

securityname.description: SNMPv3 security name. Property behavior: supported if version is set to "SNMPv3" (3).

securitylevel.description: SNMPv3 security level. Possible values: 0 - (default) noAuthNoPriv; 1 - authNoPriv; 2 - authPriv. Property behavior: supported if version is set to "SNMPv3" (3).

authpassphrase.description: SNMPv3 authentication passphrase. Property behavior: supported if version is set to "SNMPv3" (3) and securitylevel is set to "authNoPriv" (1) or "authPriv" (2).

privpassphrase.description: SNMPv3 privacy passphrase. Property behavior: supported if version is set to "SNMPv3" (3) and securitylevel is set to "authPriv" (2).

authprotocol.description: SNMPv3 authentication protocol. Possible values: 0 - (default) MD5; 1 - SHA1; 2 - SHA224; 3 - SHA256; 4 - SHA384; 5 - SHA512. Property behavior: supported if version is set to "SNMPv3" (3) and securitylevel is set to "authNoPriv" (1) or "authPriv" (2).

privprotocol.description: SNMPv3 privacy protocol. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces. Possible values: 0 - (default) DES; 1 - AES128; 2 - AES192; 3 - AES256; 4 - AES192C; 5 - AES256C. Property behavior: supported if version is set to "SNMPv3" (3) and securitylevel is set to "authPriv" (2).

contextname.description: SNMPv3 context name. Property behavior: supported if version is set to "SNMPv3" (3).

templateRef.description: Reference to an existing template by templateid only.
